桃花山刘家修仙传最新章节_第25章 在路上第1页_桃花山刘家修仙传飞云剑仙_热点小说网
> 第25章 在路上（第1页）
大长老刘秋生说道：“在出发前，长老会就预料到这种情况，只是没有想到会这么快，就用到了为邪修准备的底牌！这个底牌就是小四象混元阵，听我命令，我抓紧布阵。”
在大长老刘秋生的指挥下，众人开始布置阵法。
小四象混元阵是家族新购置的二阶下品阵法，这套阵法有108块阵盘，法阵既可以使用修士法力催动，也可以使用灵石催动。该阵法布置简单，使用方便，在四名炼气后期修士的操控下，能够和筑基初期修士对战而不落下风。
这套阵法共费灵石1万2千块，这还是刘秋菊帮着，向宗门阵法师购置的。毕竟很少有散修和家族修士能够成为二阶阵法师。
很快在众人的努力下阵法就布置好了，加上灵石后，立即启动阵法，方圆二里均被阵法光幕覆盖。
在准备好了以后，又等待了一段时间，远处人影绰绰，邪修们来了！
这些邪修头上均蒙着能遮挡神识的黑纱，只露出两只眼睛，身穿黑色夜行衣，手中握着泛着寒光的各式法器快速来到阵前。
“杀！杀！杀！”没有多余的废话，这群邪修的首领，一位身材魁梧的炼气大圆满修士一声令下，众邪修向着法阵杀来！
邪修首领则是御使长约一丈的一阶极品法器长枪，如一道黑色长虹划过长空，飞向法阵，将阵法光幕撞击的灵光闪耀，发出雷鸣般的响声，但是，法阵安然无恙。二阶阵法显然不是炼气修士能轻易撼动的！
光挨打不还手，显然不是刘氏家族的风格，只见大长老刘秋生操控阵法凝聚出一道道燃烧着红色火焰的朱雀虚影，向着邪修们飞去。有两名炼气中期的邪修，因为躲闪不及被从天而降的火焰烧成灰烬！
看到小四象混元阵的强大威力，家族众修士一时间精神振奋，纷纷加大向法阵中注入法力，操控法阵向邪修攻击。
邪修们见状，纷纷退到法阵攻击范围以外，几个邪修首领在一起商量办法。
几位修士首领商议之后，率领众邪修再次发动攻击。
这次邪修们改变了原来的战术，不敢太过靠近阵法，只是远远的用法术、符箓和飞剑攻击。
其中一位邪修首领则在后面祭出一个符箓，只是这是一只二阶攻击符箓，这是二阶下品陨石符。只见漫天陨石落在法阵光幕上，摩擦撕裂出道道裂缝，很多邪修趁势加大了攻击力度，使阵法变得摇摇欲坠。
这时又有一名邪修首领祭出二阶下品符箓火雨符，漫天火雨落在法阵光幕上，凶猛的火焰将光幕烧出道道裂缝。
大长老刘秋生赶紧组织族人加大法力催动法阵，凝聚出漫天水浪将火焰熄灭！
紧接着，又催动法阵凝聚白虎虚影，发出无数道金光射向邪修，又造成多位邪修死伤。

于是，这场激烈的战斗，就这样一直焦灼着进行，从深夜一直战到黎明。
邪修们一度攻进法阵，但都被家族众修士赶了出来。
邪修们损失惨重，家族修士们也死伤了多人。

The latest chapter of The Liu Family's Cultivation of Immortality in Peach Blossom Mountain_Chapter 25 On the Road Page 1_The Feiyun Sword Immortal in the Peach Blossom Mountain Liu Family's Cultivation of Immortality_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 25 On the Road (Page 1)
The Great Elder Liu Qiusheng said: "Before setting off, the Council of Elders had anticipated this situation, but they did not expect that it would happen so quickly. The trump card prepared for the evil cultivators would be used! This trump card is the Little Four Elephants Hunyuan Formation. Follow my orders and I will quickly set up the formation."
Under the command of the great elder Liu Qiusheng, everyone began to arrange the formation.
The Little Four Elephants Hunyuan Formation is a second-level low-grade formation newly purchased by the family. This formation has 108 formation disks. The formation can be activated using either monk mana or spiritual stones. This formation is simple to set up and easy to use. Under the control of four monks in the late stage of Qi Refining, it can fight against the monks in the early stage of Foundation Establishment without falling behind.
This formation cost a total of 12,000 spiritual stones, which was purchased from the sect formation master with Liu Qiuju's help. After all, there are very few casual cultivators and family cultivators who can become second-level array mages.
Soon, with everyone's efforts, the formation was set up. After adding the spirit stones, the formation was immediately activated, and a two-mile radius was covered by the formation light curtain.
After getting ready, I waited for a while, and saw figures in the distance. The evil cultivators were coming!
These evil cultivators all had their heads covered with black gauze that could block their spiritual consciousness. Only their two eyes were exposed. They were wearing black night clothes and holding various magical weapons with cold light in their hands. They quickly came to the front of the formation.
"Kill! Kill! Kill!" Without any unnecessary nonsense, the leader of this group of evil cultivators, a burly Qi Refining Dzogchen cultivator, gave an order, and all the evil cultivators came towards the magic circle to kill!
The leader of the evil cultivator was using a first-class magical weapon about one foot long, a spear, which flew across the sky like a black rainbow and flew towards the magic circle. The aura of the light curtain that hit the magic circle shone brightly and made a thunderous sound. However, the magic circle was safe and sound. The second-level formation is obviously not something that a Qi Refining cultivator can easily shake!
It was obviously not the style of the Liu family to just take a beating without fighting back. The great elder Liu Qiusheng manipulated the formation to condense a series of Suzaku shadows burning with red flames, and flew towards the evil cultivators. Two evil cultivators who were in the middle stage of Qi refining were burned to ashes by the flames falling from the sky because they couldn't dodge!
Seeing the powerful power of the Little Four Elephants Hunyuan Formation, the monks in the family were immediately invigorated. They increased the amount of mana they injected into the array and controlled it to attack the evil cultivators.
Upon seeing this, the evil cultivators retreated outside the attack range of the magic circle, and several evil cultivator leaders discussed a solution together.
After discussion, several monk leaders led the evil cultivators to attack again.
This time the evil cultivators changed their original tactics and did not dare to get too close to the formation. They only used spells, talismans and flying swords to attack from a distance.
One of the evil cultivator leaders offered a talisman from behind, but it was a second-level attack talisman, a second-level low-grade meteorite talisman. I saw meteorites all over the sky falling on the light screen of the magic formation, causing cracks to tear apart due to friction. Many evil cultivators took advantage of the situation to increase their attack intensity, making the formation shaky.
At this time, another evil cultivator leader used the second-level low-grade talisman Fire Rain Talisman. Fire rain fell from the sky on the light screen of the magic circle, and the fierce flames burned the light screen into cracks.
The great elder Liu Qiusheng quickly organized his tribe to increase their magic power and activate the magic circle, condensing waves of water in the sky to extinguish the flames!
Immediately afterwards, he activated the magic circle to condense the phantom of the white tiger, and sent out countless rays of golden light towards the evil cultivators, causing death and injury to many evil cultivators.
As a result, this fierce battle continued anxiously, from late night to dawn.
The evil cultivators once attacked the magic circle, but were driven out by the family cultivators.
The evil cultivators suffered heavy losses, and many family cultivators were killed and injured.
